name: Detonation at a Distance
summary: In Moonbrook, blasts beneath Westfall have drawn SI:7's attention. Jasper Fel, a Stormwind operative, sends a remote detonator kit to let you handle the work from a safe distance.

sections.title: Eyes in the Shadows
sections.body: Jasper Fel and SI:7 watch events across Stormwind's lands, including Westfall's troubled border. When word reaches him of explosive work in Moonbrook, Fel already knows what is happening in the abandoned mining tunnels beneath the countryside.

sections.title: A Prototype Solution
sections.body: Explosions in tight caves endanger anyone nearby. Jasper Fel gives you a prototype Remote Detonator Kit made by Alliance-aligned engineers. It lets charges beneath Westfall be set off from outside. He sends you with the kit to Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind's Dwarven District and warns you not to mention SI:7 to your elven allies.

aliases: who gives detonation at a distance
faq.answer: Jasper Fel is an operative with Stormwind's intelligence service, SI:7. He watches covert threats across the kingdom and supplies tools to deal with them.

faq.q: Why does SI:7 care about Moonbrook?
faq.answer: Bandits and outlaws hold Moonbrook, whose surface leads into the Deadmines. Demolition deep beneath Westfall has caught Stormwind's intelligence network's attention.
Sprite Jumpsprocket is a gnome engineer in Stormwind's Dwarven District. She is preparing explosives for the demolition.

faq.q: Who is the 'elf friend' Jasper Fel mentions?
faq.answer: Jasper Fel means Alba Fairmoon, the elf investigating Westfall's poison who sent you to find explosives. SI:7 keeps its direct support hidden from outside allies.

faq.q: What is the Remote Detonator Kit used for?
faq.answer: The Remote Detonator Kit triggers demolition charges from a safe distance. It lets operatives clear or collapse underground passages without being trapped inside.

faq.q: Where does this quest take you?
faq.answer: You carry the detonator kit to Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind City's Dwarven District.

angles.text: As a rogue, your meeting with Jasper Fel gives you a glimpse of SI:7's covert network. It watches field operatives and quietly supplies them with tools.
As a gnome, Sprite Jumpsprocket's work shows how gnome engineering supplies Stormwind's spies with prototypes.
As an Alliance member, you see Stormwind trying to reclaim Westfall through covert engineering and intelligence rather than open military force.
As an engineer, you can appreciate a prototype detonator that sets off charges from afar, avoiding risky manual fuses in cave demolitions.
